definitions.explanation: A comprehensive philosophy or outlook on the world and one's place in it.
The overall atmosphere, rules, and setting of a creative work such as a novel, game, anime, or film. Very commonly used in discussions of fiction and media in Japanese.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{世界観|せかいかん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{独特|どくとく}→独特：01656_dokutoku⟧だ。
⟦{旅|たび}→旅：03407_tabi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通|とお}して→通す：02300_toosu⟧{世界観|せかいかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わった→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。

⟦{宗教|しゅうきょう}→宗教：03208_shuukyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{世界観|せかいかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}を{与|あた}える→影響を与える：26072_eikyouwoataeru⟧。

examples.english: In fantasy works, it's important to first build a thorough world-setting.

notes:
{世界観|せかいかん} has two distinct uses in modern Japanese.

Sense 1 (philosophical worldview) is the original meaning, corresponding to the German "Weltanschauung."

Sense 2 (fictional world-setting) is extremely common in pop culture discussions. When fans talk about a game, anime, or novel's {世界観|せかいかん}, they mean its atmosphere, rules, lore, and overall creative vision.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {世界観|せかいかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がる→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧ (the world expands)
- {世界観|せかいかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{作|つく}り{込|こ}む (build out a world-setting in detail)
- {世界観|せかいかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{壊|こわ}す→壊す：01241_kowasu⟧ (break the world-setting / ruin the atmosphere)
- ⟦{独特|どくとく}→独特：01656_dokutoku⟧な{世界観|せかいかん} (a unique worldview/world-setting)
